from collections import Counter
def comps(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); res=[]; seen=set()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if (r,c) in seen: continue
            v=g[r][c]; q=[(r,c)]; comp=[]; seen.add((r,c))
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and (ny,nx) not in seen and g[ny][nx]==v:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            res.append((v,comp))
    return res
# Hypothesis: noise = singletons; recolor to color of nearest big-comp bbox (Chebyshev from bbox top-left corner); tie-break by larger comp. Verify all demos.
def f(g, metric='tl'):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs=comps(g)
    bigs=[(v,sorted(comp)) for v,comp in cs if len(comp)>=2]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for v,comp in [(x,y) for x,y in zip(cs,[c for _,c in cs]) if False]: pass
    singles=[(v,comp[0]) for v,comp in cs if len(comp)==1]
    for v,(r,c) in singles:
        best=None
        for vv,bc in bigs:
            ys=[y for y,x in bc]; xs=[x for y,x in bc]
            r0,r1=min(ys),max(ys); c0,c1=min(xs),max(xs)
            corners=[(r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)]
            ds=[max(abs(r-yr),abs(c-xc)) for yr,xc in corners]
            d=min(ds)
            n=len(bc)
            if best is None or d<best[0]-1e-9 or (abs(d-best[0])<1e-9 and n>best[2]):
